title: Default sizes of widgets added to desktop from the app should be enough to accommodate their contents entirely
line: Charts added to the desktop from System Monitor with "Add Chart as Desktop Widget" now open large enough to show all their text.
explanation: The desktop sizes a new widget from its preferred size and grows it when the size hints change, but the Text Only and Horizontal Bars faces (used by System Monitor's Networks and Disks charts, and the Disk Usage widget) only reported the title width as preferred width and no preferred height. So these widgets stayed at the 8-gridUnit minimum and their labels, values and rows were elided or cut off. The faces now report the width and height of their content as their preferred size (Text Only also counts its legend's preferred width), so the desktop grows them to fit.

commits.message:
faces: give Text Only and Horizontal Bars a preferred size for their content

Both faces only reported the title width as their preferred width and no
preferred height, so a chart added to the desktop got the minimum size and
its rows were elided or cut off. Use the size of their content instead.

BUG: 442703

From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] faces: give Text Only and Horizontal Bars a preferred size
 for their content

Both faces only reported the title width as their preferred width and no
preferred height, so a chart added to the desktop got the minimum size and
its rows were elided or cut off. Use the size of their content instead.

BUG: 442703
---
 .../horizontalbars/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml         | 3 ++-
 .../facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml  | 4 +++-
 2 files changed, 5 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml b/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml
index e6243c7c..230f23cb 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml
@@ -22,7 +22,8 @@ Faces.SensorFace {
 
     // Arbitrary minimumWidth to make easier to align plasmoids in a predictable way
     Layout.minimumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 8
-    Layout.preferredWidth: titleMetrics.width
+    Layout.preferredWidth: Math.max(titleMetrics.width, contentItem.implicitWidth)
+    Layout.preferredHeight: contentItem.implicitHeight
 
     contentItem: ColumnLayout {

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml

+++ b/faces/facepackages/textonly/contents/ui/FullRepresentation.qml
@@ -22,7 +22,8 @@ Faces.SensorFace {
 
     // Arbitrary minimumWidth to make easier to align plasmoids in a predictable way
     Layout.minimumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 8
-    Layout.preferredWidth: Math.max(Layout.minimumWidth, titleMetrics.width)
+    Layout.preferredWidth: Math.max(Layout.minimumWidth, titleMetrics.width, groupedText.contentWidth)
+    Layout.preferredHeight: contentItem.implicitHeight
 
     contentItem: ColumnLayout {
         spacing: 0
@@ -49,6 +50,7 @@ Faces.SensorFace {
         }
 
         GroupedText {
+            id: groupedText
             totalSensorIds: root.controller.totalSensors

review.text: Targeted fix in libksysguard giving the Text Only and Horizontal Bars SensorFace implementations content-based Layout.preferredWidth and Layout.preferredHeight instead of reporting only the title width and no preferred height. Before/after screenshots confirm Networks and Disks charts added from System Monitor now open large enough to show their labels and values without elision or clipping, and user-resized widgets keep their saved geometry across restarts. Minor note: Horizontal Bars still elides very long sensor names slightly due to maximumValueWidth: 2 * gridUnit, which is reasonably left untouched to avoid changing in-app eliding.

reviews.text: Targeted fix in libksysguard giving the Text Only and Horizontal Bars SensorFace implementations content-based Layout.preferredWidth and Layout.preferredHeight instead of reporting only the title width and no preferred height. Before/after screenshots confirm Networks and Disks charts added from System Monitor now open large enough to show their labels and values without elision or clipping, and user-resized widgets keep their saved geometry across restarts. Minor note: Horizontal Bars still elides very long sensor names slightly due to maximumValueWidth: 2 * gridUnit, which is reasonably left untouched to avoid changing in-app eliding.

Giving the Text Only and Horizontal Bars faces a content-based preferred size is the right layer: the line, pie and bar faces already report legend.preferredWidth, and the Networks/Disks before/after shots show a real improvement. But the title asks for contents to fit entirely, and Horizontal Bars still counts every value as a fixed 2 gridUnits (maximumValueWidth), so a long sensor name still elides at default size, as the fixer's own after-2 shows ('Percentage U...'). A Disks chart with a real device label would hit the same thing. The earlier rig run (2026-10-22) also saw later charts from 'Add Chart as Desktop Widget' land at 68x68 and stacked on one spot, and this verification didn't re-check that.
changes: Make Horizontal Bars' preferred width use the real width of the value text (e.g. Formatter.maximumLength or the delegate's value implicitWidth) instead of the fixed 2-gridUnit maximumValueWidth, so the name and value both fit at the default size; show the Disk Usage/Disks widget with no elision.

Re-test adding three or four charts in a row from plasma-systemmonitor's Overview and confirm none get 68x68 or stack on the same spot; if they still do, fix that placement too or explain why it's out of scope.
